subject: Request: LumenWorks accelerator credit + trial extension (exec escalation)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@lumenworks.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenworks.com
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension + credits — LumenWorks accelerator program

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and the inference controls. We pushed a short internal review and have two asks that would let us move from POC to an internal pilot across two product teams: 1) a short trial extension (we need another 60 days to run deeper load/quality checks across longer sequences) and 2) a promotional credit to offset incremental token costs during the extended pilot (we're asking for $5k of credits applied to the pilot account).

We also have a procurement window in mid-September, so if we can lock a short-term extension + credits and a note on the SLA for the pilot, we can accelerate the evaluation.

Attached is a usage extract and a one-page summary of our expected traffic pattern. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

— Samir
Director of ML Ops, LumenWorks
Attachments: lumen_q2_usage_summary.csv
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumenworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension + credits — LumenWorks accelerator program

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the clear ask and the usage file. Quick answers: we're open to a 60-day extension and we can propose a $5k credit applied to the pilot account, but the combined credit + extension is an exception to standard PLG policy so I need exec sign-off. I’ve drafted an offer that balances unit economics and guardrails:

- 60-day trial extension (no change to billing during extension)
- $5,000 promotional credit applied to usage over the extension period
- A one-time 10% pilot discount on committed usage if they convert within 90 days after pilot
- A temporary SLA note for the pilot (best-effort, with a documented escalation path)

I attached the proposed offer and a short note for approvals (proposed-accelerator-offer-v2.pdf). Ben, can you confirm the margin impact? Marissa — would you prefer this routed through renewals or exec? I’m placing it in my inbox for escalation given the credit size and the pilot timeline.

Naomi Feldman
Account Executive — Strategic Startups
Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed-accelerator-offer-v2.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension + credits — LumenWorks accelerator program

Naomi — I reviewed the numbers. $5k credit over a 60-day extension is within our accelerator budget for deals with strategic expansion potential. Margin impact is acceptable if we require commitment language on conversion timing and a short review after 30 days. Recommend we escalate for exec sign-off with those conditions.

Ben
Sales Ops Manager
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: LumenWorks — request approval for extension + $5k credits

Hi Vivek —

Passing along a compact ask from Naomi for an exception: LumenWorks (high-signal prospect) is requesting a 60-day pilot extension and $5k in promotional credits so they can complete a two-team evaluation. Ben has verified margin impact and suggests we condition approval on:

- Commitment: written intent to negotiate conversion within 90 days of pilot end
- 30-day review: internal checkpoint to validate usage and quality regressions
- Attachment: SOC2 summary (they requested evidence; we can share our public SOC2 note)

I’ve included the proposed offer PDF and the usage CSV for context. DocuSign link below is pre-populated to make approval fast (it’s the standard promo escalation template). If you’re OK, please sign off and I’ll notify Samir by EOD so they can schedule their expanded tests.

DocuSign: https://naomi.redwoodinternal/docusign/ENVELOPE-9921
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/98421/company/45732

Thanks — Marissa
VP, Sales — Enterprise & Strategic
Attachments: soc2-summary.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escalation: LumenWorks — request approval for extension + $5k credits

Marissa / Naomi —

Approved with conditions. Please proceed with the offer and notify LumenWorks:

1) Approve the 60-day extension and $5,000 promotional credit.
2) Require the written conversion intent (email confirmation from LumenWorks procurement) within 90 days of pilot end.
3) Schedule a 30-day internal checkpoint (assign to Naomi) to review usage and quality signals; if usage patterns are materially different from the submitted CSV, escalate back to Sales Ops.
4) Do not increase the credit amount or add further SLA guarantees. Pilot SLA note is best-effort only.

Naomi — once you have the procurement confirmation, please trigger the credit in billing and notify Samir. Marissa — please sign the DocuSign envelope so we have a record of exec approval.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
